note: An `ext` member is refused — identify is closed so a VTA signing it without user verification cannot be made to sign anything else (additionalProperties: false, no ext).
Smuggled authority — a sessionKey in identify is rejected; only a user-verified grant may name a session key.
enteredNumber must be exactly two digits, as a string.
approverKey must be an Ed25519 did:key — a did:web lock is refused.
Missing enteredNumber — the number proof is required.
